One system dialog. Android then watches for this sensor by itself, wakes the app when it is in range and lets it sync in the background while it is near.
The Bluetooth link drops for the dialog and comes back after it.

A background job copies new files with a progress notification. Android picks the exact moment and skips it on low battery. Joining a Wi-Fi network also starts a check. Files are checked exactly like Sync all, and the sensor is never asked to delete anything.
